title: Compound decisions and empirical Bayes via Bayesian nonparametrics
abstract: arXiv:2602.20115v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study compound decision theory from a nonparametric Bayesian perspective, with particular emphasis on their relationship to empirical Bayes (EB) procedures. Motivated by the sharp risk guarantees available for EB procedures based on the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE), we investigate whether analogous guarantees can be established for fully Bayesian decision rules. In a class of Gaussian compound decision problems, we show that the fully Bayesian posterior mean achieves near-optimal risk. Moreover, it is admissible as a genuine Bayes rule, whereas the corresponding NPMLE plug-in rule is inadmissible. Simulations illustrate the performance of nonparametric Bayes procedures relative to common alternatives. As an application, we apply our methodology to Census tract-level estimates of economic mobility from the Opportunity Atlas.

translated_title: 基于贝叶斯非参数方法的复合决策与经验贝叶斯
translated_abstract: 我们从非参数贝叶斯的视角研究复合决策理论，特别关注其与经验贝叶斯（EB）方法之间的关系。受基于非参数极大似然估计（NPMLE）的经验贝叶斯方法所具有的精确风险保证的启发，我们研究是否可以为完全贝叶斯决策规则建立类似的风险保证。在一类高斯复合决策问题中，我们证明了完全贝叶斯后验均值能够达到近似最优的风险。此外，作为真正的贝叶斯规则，它是可容许的，而相应的NPMLE代入规则则是不可容许的。模拟实验展示了非参数贝叶斯方法相对于常见替代方法的性能。作为应用，我们将该方法应用于Opportunity Atlas中人口普查区级经济流动性的估计。
tldr: 该论文从非参数贝叶斯视角研究复合决策理论，证明完全贝叶斯后验均值在高斯复合决策问题中能达到近似最优风险且作为真正的贝叶斯规则具有可容许性，而相应的NPMLE代入规则则不可容许。
